a1-greetings.title: Greetings: Marhaba and Kifak
a1-greetings.explanation: "مرحبا" (marhaba) is the everyday hello you'll hear everywhere in Syria — shops, taxis, cafés. "كيفك؟" (kifak, to a man) / "كيفك؟" (kifik, to a woman) asks "how are you?" — instantly recognizable as Levantine rather than textbook Arabic. The typical answer is "الحمدلله منيح" (alhamdulillah, mnih — "thank God, good"), with منيح becoming منيحة (mniha) when a woman is speaking about herself.
a1-greetings.fact: "صباح الخير" (sabah el-kheir, good morning) gets answered not by repeating it, but with "صباح النور" (sabah en-noor, literally "morning of light") — like many Arabic greeting pairs, the reply uses a different word entirely rather than echoing the greeting back.

a1-biddi.title: I Want: Biddi
a1-biddi.explanation: "بدي" (biddi) is the everyday way to say "I want" in Syrian Arabic — one of the most common words you'll hear. Just follow it with what you want: "بدي قهوة" (biddi ahwe, "I want coffee").
a1-biddi.fact: بدي is actually بدّ (badd-, "want/need") fused with the possessive ending "-i" (my), so it literally means something like "my wanting" — the same possessive-suffix logic that gives Arabic its other person forms of this word, though this course only teaches the widely-used 1st-person بدي form for now.

dialogue.en: I want coffee today, thank you very much

a1-present-shaf.title: Present Tense: I See, You See...
a1-present-shaf.pattern: ب- / بت- / بتي- / بي- / بت- / من- / بتو- / بي-و
a1-present-shaf.explanation: Syrian present-tense verbs take the ب- (b-) prefix plus a person marker: بشوف (bshuf, "I see"), بتشوف (btshuf, "you-m see"), بتشوفي (btshufi, "you-f see"), بيشوف (byshuf, "he sees"), بتشوف (btshuf, "she sees"), منشوف (mnshuf, "we see"), بتشوفو (btshufu, "you-all see"), بيشوفو (byshufu, "they see").
a1-present-shaf.fact: The 1st person plural "we" prefix (من mn-) looks completely different from the ب- pattern everywhere else — that's not an exception to memorize separately, it's just what happens when ب- fuses with the underlying "n-" marker for "we", a regular sound change across the whole b-prefix system.

dialogue.en: I see a big house today

a1-fi-mafi.title: There Is / There Isn't: Fi and Mafi
a1-fi-mafi.explanation: "فيه" (fi) means "there is/are", and its negative "مافي" (mafi, from ما + فيه) means "there isn't/aren't". This simple pair is so central to everyday Levantine speech that a well-known textbook is literally named "Shou fi ma fi?" ("What's up? / What's there, what's not there?").
a1-fi-mafi.fact: "شو في ما في؟" is itself a common colloquial greeting/small-talk phrase meaning roughly "what's going on?" — literally "what is there, what isn't there" — showing how naturally فيه/مافي gets used beyond its literal grammatical meaning.

items.translit: el-beit a7mar, wa haad ktir mnih

items.ar: ولد صغير، وبنت صغيرة، والأهل منيحين
items.en: A small boy, a small girl, and the family is good
items.translit: walad sgheer, wa bint sgheera, wal-ahl mnihin

items.ar: شو هاد؟ بدي بشوف الأهل، والحمدلله
items.en: What is this? I want to see the family, thank God
items.translit: shu haad? biddi bshuf el-ahl, wal-hamdulillah

items.ar: واحد وتنين وتلاتة، كم هاد؟ هاد رخيص
items.en: One, two, three, how much is this? This is cheap
items.translit: wahed wa tnein wa tlete, kam haad? haad rkhees

items.ar: ستة وسبعة وتمانية، هاد غالي والحمدلله
items.en: Six, seven, eight, this is expensive, thank God
items.translit: sitte wa sab3a wa tmanye wal-hamdulillah

items.ar: تسعة وعشرة، وين الفلوس؟ هاد كتير غالي
items.en: Nine and ten, where's the money? This is very expensive
items.translit: tis3a wa 3ashara, wein el-fluus? haad ktir ghali

items.ar: أديش هاد؟ خمسة، ورخيص والحمدلله يا صديق
items.en: How much is this? Five, and cheap, thank God, friend
items.translit: addesh haad? khamse, wa rkhees wal-hamdulillah ya sadeeq

items.ar: يوم الجمعة بدي قهوة، ويوم السبت بدي شاي
items.en: On Friday I want coffee, and on Saturday I want tea
items.translit: yom el-jum3a biddi ahwe, wa yom es-sabt biddi shay

items.ar: اليوم يوم الأحد، وبدي بشوف صديقي بكرة
items.en: Today is Sunday, and I want to see my friend tomorrow
items.translit: el-yom yom el-a7ad, wa biddi bshuf sadee2i bukra

items.ar: يوم الاثنين بدي بيت جديد، والحمدلله
items.en: On Monday I want a new house, thank God
items.translit: yom el-tnein biddi beit jdeed, wal-hamdulillah

items.ar: مدري شو بكرة، بس اليوم منيح والحمدلله يا صديق
items.en: I don't know what's tomorrow, but today is good, thank God, friend
items.translit: midri shu bukra, bas el-yom mnih wal-hamdulillah ya sadeeq

items.ar: بيشوف بيت كبير اليوم، وبتشوف بيت صغير بكرة
items.en: He sees a big house today, and you see a small house tomorrow
items.translit: byshuf beit kbeer el-yom, wa btshuf beit sgheer bukra

items.en: They see a car, and we see an old house
items.translit: byshufu sayyara, wa mnshuf beit 2adeem

items.en: What does he see? He sees coffee and tea
items.translit: shu byshuf? byshuf ahwe wa shay

items.ar: مين بيشوف البيت؟ صديقي بيشوف البيت
items.en: Who sees the house? My friend sees the house
items.translit: miin byshuf el-beit? sadee2i byshuf el-beit

items.ar: بحب قهوة اليوم، وبتحب شاي بكرة
items.en: I love coffee today, and you love tea tomorrow
items.translit: bhib ahwe el-yom, wa bthib shay bukra

items.ar: بيحب بيت كبير، وبتحبي بيت صغير
items.en: He loves a big house, and you (f) love a small house
items.translit: byhib beit kbeer, wa bthibbi beit sgheer

items.ar: شو بتحب؟ بحب قهوة وشاي والحمدلله
items.en: What do you love? I love coffee and tea, thank God
items.translit: shu bthib? bhib ahwe wa shay wal-hamdulillah

items.en: And we love the family, and we love our friend
items.translit: wa mnhib el-ahl, wa mnhib sadee2na

items.ar: في بيت هون، ومافي بيت هونيك
items.en: There's a house here, and there's no house there
items.translit: fii beit hown, wa mafi beit hownik

items.ar: في سيارة قريبة، بس مافي سيارة بعيدة
items.en: There's a car nearby, but there's no car far away
items.translit: fii sayyara 2areebe, bas mafi sayyara ba3eede

items.ar: في قهوة وشاي، ومافي مي هلق
items.en: There's coffee and tea, and there's no water now
items.translit: fii ahwe wa shay, wa mafi mai hala2

items.ar: في مشكلة؟ مافي مشكلة، منيح والحمدلله
items.en: Is there a problem? No problem, good, thank God
items.translit: fii mushkile? mafi mushkile, mnih wal-hamdulillah

items.ar: ما بدي هاد البيت، بدي بيت جديد
items.en: I don't want this house, I want a new house
items.translit: ma biddi haad el-beit, biddi beit jdeed

items.ar: هاد مش غالي، هاد رخيص والحمدلله
items.en: This isn't expensive, this is cheap, thank God
items.translit: haad mish ghali, haad rkhees wal-hamdulillah

items.ar: أنا مش تعبان، أنا منيح والحمدلله يا صديق
items.en: I'm not tired, I'm good, thank God, friend
items.translit: ana mish ta3ban, ana mnih wal-hamdulillah ya sadeeq

items.ar: ما بدي قهوة هلق، بدي شاي بكرة
items.en: I don't want coffee now, I want tea tomorrow
items.translit: ma biddi ahwe hala2, biddi shay bukra

items.ar: مين هاد؟ هاد صديقي، وهو منيح
items.en: Who is this? This is my friend, and he's good
items.translit: miin haad? haad sadee2i, wa huwwe mnih

items.ar: شو بدي؟ بدي قهوة وشاي والحمدلله
items.en: What do I want? I want coffee and tea, thank God
items.translit: shu biddi? biddi ahwe wa shay wal-hamdulillah

items.ar: وين الأهل؟ الأهل هونيك، بعيد شوي
items.en: Where's the family? The family is over there, a bit far
items.translit: wein el-ahl? el-ahl hownik, ba3eed

items.ar: كيف البيت الجديد؟ البيت منيح وكبير والحمدلله
items.en: How's the new house? The house is good and big, thank God
items.translit: kiif el-beit ej-jdeed? el-beit mnih wa kbeer wal-hamdulillah

items.ar: ليش هاد غالي؟ مدري، بس هاد جديد
items.en: Why is this expensive? I don't know, but this is new
items.translit: leish haad ghali? midri, bas haad jdeed

items.ar: إيمتى بتشوف الأهل؟ بشوف الأهل بكرة والحمدلله
items.en: When do you see the family? I see the family tomorrow, thank God
items.translit: eimta btshuf el-ahl? bshuf el-ahl bukra wal-hamdulillah

items.ar: ليش مافي قهوة هلق؟ في شاي بس
items.en: Why is there no coffee now? There's only tea
items.translit: leish mafi ahwe hala2? fii shay bas

items.ar: إيمتى هاد؟ هاد اليوم، مش بكرة
items.en: When is this? This is today, not tomorrow
items.translit: eimta haad? haad el-yom, mish bukra

items.ar: بحب هاد البيت الأحمر اليوم، وبدي بيت أزرق بكرة
items.en: I love this red house today, and I want a blue house tomorrow
items.translit: bhib haad el-beit el-a7mar el-yom, wa biddi beit azra2 bukra

items.ar: بشوف بيت أخضر، وبتشوف بيت أصفر
items.en: I see a green house, and you see a yellow house
items.translit: bshuf beit akhdar, wa btshuf beit asfar

items.ar: هاد بيت أبيض، وهاد بيت أسود بعيد
items.en: This is a white house, and this is a black house far away
items.translit: haad beit abyad, wa haad beit iswad ba3eed

items.ar: بحب قهوة وشاي اليوم، وبدي بيت أحمر بكرة
items.en: I love coffee and tea today, and I want a red house tomorrow
items.translit: bhib ahwe wa shay el-yom, wa biddi beit a7mar bukra

items.en: My friend is good, and the family is good
items.translit: sadee2i mnih, wal-ahl mnihin

items.ar: بشوف صديقي اليوم، وبشوف الأهل بكرة والحمدلله
items.en: I see my friend today, and I see the family tomorrow, thank God
items.translit: bshuf sadee2i el-yom, wa bshuf el-ahl bukra wal-hamdulillah

items.ar: هاد أب منيح، وهاد صديق منيح
items.en: This is a good father, and this is a good friend
items.translit: haad ab mnih, wa haad sadeeq mnih

items.ar: الأهل هون، وصديقي هونيك، ومنيحين والحمدلله
items.en: The family is here, and my friend is there, and they're good, thank God
items.translit: el-ahl hown, wa sadee2i hownik, wa mnihin wal-hamdulillah

items.ar: بشوف، وبتشوف، وبيشوف، ومنشوف، منشوف البيت
items.en: I see, and you see, and he sees, and we see, we see the house
items.translit: bshuf, wa btshuf, wa byshuf, wa mnshuf el-beit

items.ar: بحب قهوة، وبتحب شاي، وبيحب مي، منيح والحمدلله
items.en: I love coffee, you love tea, he loves water, good, thank God
items.translit: bhib ahwe, wa bthib shay, wa byhib mai, wal-hamdulillah

items.ar: بدي بيت، وبحب قهوة، منيح والحمدلله
items.en: I want a house, and I love coffee, good, thank God
items.translit: biddi beit, wa bhib ahwe, wal-hamdulillah

items.ar: مدري شو بدي اليوم، بس بدي بشوف الأهل بكرة
items.en: I don't know what I want today, but I want to see the family tomorrow
items.translit: midri shu biddi el-yom, bas biddi bshuf el-ahl bukra

items.ar: صباح الخير يا صديق، كيفك؟ منيح والحمدلله
items.en: Good morning, friend, how are you? Good, thank God
items.translit: saba7 el-kheir ya sadeeq, kiifak? mnih wal-hamdulillah

items.ar: بدي قهوة اليوم، وبشوف الأهل بكرة، منيح كتير
items.en: I want coffee today, and I see the family tomorrow, very good
items.translit: biddi ahwe el-yom, wa bshuf el-ahl bukra, mnih ktir

items.ar: البيت الجديد قريب، والبيت القديم هونيك
items.en: The new house is near, and the old house is over there
items.translit: el-beit ej-jdeed 2areeb, wal-beit el-2adeem hownik

items.ar: مافي مشكلة، أنا منيح والحمدلله يا صديق، شكراً كتير
items.en: No problem, I'm good, thank God, friend, thank you very much
items.translit: mafi mushkile, ana mnih wal-hamdulillah ya sadeeq

lessons.title: My Friend and My House
lessons.context: A simple introduction to a friend and a house.

paragraphs.en: Hi, friend! How are you today?
I'm good today, thank God.

paragraphs.ar: بيتي كبير وقديم، بس منيح كتير.
paragraphs.en: My house is big and old, but very good.
My car is small, and my house is white.
My friend is very good today.

questions.question: How does the speaker feel today?
What is the speaker's house like?
What color is the speaker's house?
How is the speaker's friend today?

lessons.title: Tea and Coffee
lessons.context: A short passage about tea and coffee.

paragraphs.en: Good morning, friend!
Good morning (reply)! I want tea today.
Tea is very good in the morning.

paragraphs.ar: أنا بدي قهوة، القهوة منيحة كتير.
paragraphs.en: I want coffee, coffee is very good.
Good! Thank you, friend.

questions.question: What does the first friend want?
What does the second friend want?

paragraphs.en: Peace be upon you! How are you today?
And peace be upon you, I'm good, thank God.

paragraphs.ar: أنا شوي تعبان اليوم يا صديق.
paragraphs.en: I'm a little tired today, friend.
No problem, tomorrow good a lot (skip idiom).
Thank you! Good morning, friend.

questions.question: How does the second speaker feel today?
What does the first speaker say there's no problem about?

paragraphs.en: One, two, three, four, five.
Six, seven, eight, nine, ten.
How much is this? This is five.
And this (fem)? This is ten.
Good! Thank you, friend.

lessons.title: Complete: A Big House, A Small Car
lessons.context: A short story about a house and a car.

paragraphs.ar: بيتنا كبير وقديم، بس منيح كتير.
paragraphs.en: Our house is big and old, but very good.
Our car is small, and our house is red.
Our friend loves the small car a lot.

paragraphs.ar: البيت الكبير منيح، والسيارة الصغيرة منيحة.
paragraphs.en: The big house is good, and the small car is good.
Where is our friend today? Here, here!

lessons.title: Far and Close
lessons.context: A passage about distance and family.

paragraphs.en: Our house is close, and our friend's house is far.
My father and mother's house is close.
My daughter and my son are good today.
The car is a little far, but it's good.
Tomorrow we'll see our far friend.

questions.question: Who is at the close house?
When will they see the far friend?

paragraphs.ar: أديش هاد البيت؟ هاد البيت غالي.
paragraphs.en: How much is this house? This house is expensive.
And this car? This is very cheap.
Tea is cheap, and coffee is a little expensive.
I want tea, it's cheap and good.
Thank you very much, friend!

lessons.title: Where Is My Friend?
lessons.context: A short passage using question words.

paragraphs.en: Where is my friend? He's here.
Who is this? This is my friend.
What is this? This is tea.
How is my friend today? Very good.
When is tomorrow? Tomorrow is not today.

lessons.title: My Family, My Colors
lessons.context: A passage combining family and colors.

paragraphs.en: My father loves the green house.
My mother loves the yellow house.
My daughter loves the blue house.
My son loves the black house.
And me? I love my friend a lot!

questions.question: What does the speaker love the most?

lessons.title: Complete: A1 Reading Wrap One
lessons.context: A review passage combining greetings, family, and colors.

paragraphs.en: Hi, friend! How are you today?
Good, thank God. The family is good today.
Our house is big and blue, and our car is small.
I want tea, and the house is very good.
Thank you very much, tomorrow we'll see our friend.

questions.question: What does the speaker say they'll do tomorrow?

lessons.title: I Don't Know
lessons.context: A passage about not knowing something.

paragraphs.ar: وين صديقي؟ مدري، هو مش هون.
paragraphs.en: Where is my friend? I don't know, he's not here.

paragraphs.ar: مين هاد؟ مدري، هاد مش صديقي.
paragraphs.en: Who is this? I don't know, this is not my friend.
I want tea, but there's no tea.
No problem, I want water.
Thank you! This water is very good.

questions.question: What does the speaker want first?
What does the speaker want instead?

lessons.title: How Many?
lessons.context: A passage using the question word 'how many'.

paragraphs.ar: كم بيت هون؟ واحد، تنين، تلاتة.
paragraphs.en: How many houses are here? One, two, three.
How many cars are here? Four, five.
My friend is good, and he's here.
How are you all today, friend?
Good, thank God!

questions.question: How does the group answer 'how are you'?

lessons.title: This Is Cheap, This Is Expensive

paragraphs.en: What is this? This is a house.

paragraphs.ar: بدي هاد البيت، هو منيح كتير.
paragraphs.en: I want this house, it's very good.
And this? This is a good car.
This house is cheap, and this is expensive.
I want the cheap one, thank you!

questions.question: What does the speaker first identify?
How is the first house described?
What does the speaker finally want?

lessons.title: Everything Is Good
lessons.context: A review passage using many A1 words together.

paragraphs.en: Good morning! How are you all today?

paragraphs.ar: منيحين، الحمدلله. البيت منيح والسيارة منيحة.
paragraphs.en: Good, thank God. The house is good and the car is good.
My friend is good, and our friend is very good.
No problem today, thank God.

paragraphs.ar: شكرا كتير! صباح النور يا صديق.
paragraphs.en: Thank you very much! Good morning, friend.

questions.question: What is described as good along with the house?

paragraphs.en: Hi, friend! How are you all today?
Very good, thank God.
Our house is big, and our car is small and good.
I want tea, there's no coffee today.
Thank you very much, good morning (reply)!
